children: Aquestive Therapeutics resubmitted its New Drug Application for Anaphylm following supportive human factors and pharmacokinetic study results.
Resubmitted NDA to FDA for Anaphylm (dibutepinephrine) sublingual film for Type I allergic reactions, including anaphylaxis.
Resubmission supported by positive topline human factors and PK study results, including reduced median pouch-open time from 17s to 3s.
FDA will classify the resubmission and set the review timeline after initial review; Aquestive may request expedited review.
No protocol-defined use errors observed in self-administration arm of the confirmatory PK study; pharmacodynamic responses comparable to clinician administration.
Company presented investor materials at H.C. Wainwright conference; presentation available on company website and incorporated into the 8-K.
